name: labs/jasapp__rigol
title: RIGOL DP832A triple-channel DC power supply
intro: RIGOL DP832A triple-channel DC power supply, adapted from jasapp/rigol. It reads `voltage_ch1`, `current_ch1`, `power_ch1`, `voltage_ch2` and 5 more; sets `output_ch1`, `voltage_setpoint_ch1`, `current_setpoint_ch1`, `output_ch2` and 5 more; runs `set_ovp` and `set_ocp`. `set_ovp`: set the over-voltage protection threshold of one channel and enable it (:OUTP:OVP). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/jasapp__rigol --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/jasapp__rigol --backend fake --mcp
